description:
I have been in the Electrical Industry for 18+ years. Starting as a 19 year old apprentice. On my journey as an apprentice electrician I became a Licensed Journeyman in the state of Texas. Having worked as a Journeyman Electrician for some years I became a Licensed Master Electrician. I operate my own Electrical Contracting Company at the age of 35. At this point in my life I have a strong urge to give my this knowledge back and continue on with my passion as an Electrician. I feel it is an honor to be an Electrician.
